searchText: What do you mean by "finalize"? I wish I had time to do a full review of all of the assertions. Hopefully someone else does'. 😖 <@!301186049323958275> I am just wondering if I have too many or too few terms listed and if it is even necessary to define terms that are already defined in my references like the yellow paper? I think defining terms that aren't common knowledge is valuable. Yeah it's not the most interesting read in the world. Including a full dictionary is not useful.
